freeMessagingDesc: Send unlimited texts, photos, videos, and files to anyone around the world — always free.
voiceVideoCallsDesc: Crystal-clear HD audio and video calls with friends, family, and teams — free and unlimited.
reelsShortsDesc: Create, watch, and share short-form videos with millions of creators worldwide.
eventsDesc: Discover and host live events, meetups, and webinars with people who share your interests.
marketplaceDesc: Buy and sell products in a safe, community-driven marketplace.
secureDesc: Your messages are protected with enterprise-grade encryption.
groupChatDesc: Create groups with unlimited members, share media, and stay connected in real-time.
lightningFastDesc: Optimized for speed - messages deliver in milliseconds worldwide.
globalReachDesc: Connect with people in 190+ countries with no VPN required.
premiumFeaturesDesc: Unlock exclusive badges, themes, and creator tools for power users.
creatorAnalyticsDesc: Track follower growth, engagement, and revenue with powerful insights.
bookmarksDesc: Save messages, posts, and reels to revisit anytime.
howItWorksDesc: Get connected in three simple steps.
step1Desc: Sign up with email or phone in seconds - no downloads or installs needed.
step2Desc: Find friends by phone, username, QR code, or nearby location.
step3Desc: Send messages, make HD calls, share stories, and create content.
joinFounding: Join the founding community and help shape the app with your feedback.
privacyDesc: Your data is yours. We use industry-standard encryption and never share your information with third parties.
foundersMessage: We started GaGa Chat with a simple idea: everyone deserves fast, private, and beautiful communication - no matter where they are. Today, we're building that dream together with you.
testimonialsDesc: Join thousands of people who love using GaGa Chat every day.
